chain.title: Threads of Brilliance
chain.desc: Gold nuggets, leaves and a tuft of grass. Placed in the crown of a tree it slowly turns the canopy to Golden Leaves.

chain.title: Harvest the Brilliant Tree
chain.desc: Break fully grown Golden Leaves for a 75% chance of Gold Leaf. Every first step in the mod is paid for in these.

chain.title: Crushed to Dust
chain.desc: Gold Leaf ground down. Sprinkled on the ground it draws the ring that the Ritual of the Forest is performed inside.

chain.title: Stands Around the Circle
chain.desc: A log topped with Gold Leaf. Each stand holds one ingredient for the Ritual of the Forest; you never need all of them.

chain.title: Carved From Gladness
chain.desc: The first Ritual of the Forest. An Aura Bottle and Gold Leaf grown through an oak sapling into a figurine of joy.

chain.title: Where Nature Is Infused
chain.desc: Stone, gold and a Token of Joy fed to an oak sapling. The altar draws ambient Aura and infuses whatever sits on it.

chain.title: Bottle and Cork
chain.desc: A glass bottle and a plank. Right-click the open air with it to catch Aura; a dispenser will do the job for you.

chain.title: Sunlight, Ghosts and Darkness
chain.desc: One item with three faces: Overworld Aura is bottled sunlight, Nether Aura is ghosts, End Aura is an excess of dark.

chain.title: Iron That Drank the Air
chain.desc: An iron ingot left on the Natural Altar until the surrounding Aura soaks into it. The mod's working metal.

chain.title: Rock, Similarly Treated
chain.desc: Stone infused on the altar. It builds the catalysts, the Aura Cache and most of the mod's machinery.

chain.title: A Pocket Full of Aura
chain.desc: Infused Iron around Infused Rock. Carried in your inventory it stores Aura and quietly pays for your trinkets.

chain.title: See What Is Not There
chain.desc: A Ritual of the Forest around Gold Leaf. Held in the offhand the Environmental Eye shows the Aura level of the chunk you stand in.

chain.title: Gold, Spoiled
chain.desc: A gold ingot infused on the altar in a low-Aura area. Where Infused Iron is nature's metal, this one is its imbalance.

chain.title: Bricks Shot Through With Gold
chain.desc: Stone bricks and Brilliant Fiber. Both catalysts are built on a frame of these.

chain.title: The Altar Learns to Grind
chain.desc: Golden Stone Bricks, Infused Rock and a Token of Anger, grown by ritual. Set beneath the altar it unlocks the crushing recipes.

chain.title: The Altar Learns to Transmute
chain.desc: The second catalyst, needing an Ingot of the Skies. It turns the altar's infusions into outright transmutations.

chain.title: A Voice That Reaches Up
chain.desc: Infused Iron, Tainted Gold and two Aura Bottles - one Overworld, one Nether. The recipe itself forces the trip below.

chain.title: Offering to the Gods
chain.desc: Infused Iron with a Token of Fear and a Token of Sorrow. Ring it with flowers, fill the bowl, and throw down a Spirit of Calling.

chain.title: What the Sky Sends Back
chain.desc: Offer Infused Iron, or Tainted Gold for a better yield, and the Ingots of the Skies rain down on the table.

chain.title: Joy, Made Greater
chain.desc: Offer a Token of Joy and the gods return its stronger form. Each of the four base tokens has such an exchange.

chain.title: Seed of an Older Forest
chain.desc: A ritual on a dark oak sapling with Gold Leaf. Ancient wood is the only wood the mod's rods and finders will accept.

chain.title: A Stick With History
chain.desc: Split from Ancient Slabs. Every finder, the Staff of Baldur and the Ender Ocular are built around one.

chain.title: Pressed Into the Deep
chain.desc: Two Ingots of the Skies, two Tainted Gold and a netherite scrap. The strongest metal Nature's Aura will make.

chain.title: Rose of Oblivion
chain.desc: Sprouts across the End island once the Ender Dragon is dead. Feed it an Ender Eye and it floods the area with Aura.

chain.title: The Ocular
chain.desc: The Environmental Eye rebuilt by ritual with a Rose of Oblivion and an Ingot of the Skies; it reads far more than Aura level.

chain.title: Something Left Over From a Birth
chain.desc: Breed two passive animals where Aura runs high and Spirits of Birthing sometimes fall out of the process.

chain.title: Altar of Birthing
chain.desc: Ingots of the Skies and a Token of Euphoria. Throw down a Spirit of Birthing with the right offerings and it grows a living creature.

chain.title: Ring of Last Chance
chain.desc: End Aura, an Ingot of the Skies and the Tokens of Euphoria and Terror. It spends Aura instead of your life.

notes: VERIFICATION: 148 stems pass (item model OR blockstate) INTERSECT (lang key OR recipe result OR loot entry OR tag OR advancement); 141 survive the obtainability audit. All 28 chain ids, 5 wheel hubs and 39 wheel members (72 ids total) were re-checked, fully namespaced, against the surviving set on a second pass whose derivation is deliberately independent of the first: exact item-model path existence plus the literal "<ns>:<path>" string appearing in the jar data trees. 0 failures. DROPS: naturesaura:book is NOT an item - data/naturesaura/recipes/book.json is a shapeless recipe whose result is patchouli:guide_book with the NBT tag {"patchouli:book":"naturesaura:book"}, exactly the Zenith pattern, so the guide book has no naturesaura-namespaced id and must not be quested as one. Also dropped: the five potted_* blocks (potted_aura_bloom, potted_aura_cactus, potted_aura_mushroom, potted_crimson_aura_mushroom, potted_warped_aura_mushroom), whose loot tables hand back minecraft:flower_pot and which have no item form; and multiblock_maker, which has a model and a lang key but appears in no recipe, loot table, tag, advancement or book page - a creative/debug structure tool with no acquisition path. COMPOSED NAMES: naturesaura:aura_bottle and naturesaura:effect_powder have item models but no item.naturesaura.<stem> key, because their names are assembled at runtime from item.naturesaura.aura_bottle.naturesaura:overworld / .nether / .end / .other and item.naturesaura.effect_powder.naturesaura:plant_boost and four siblings. Both are proven real: aura_bottle is the icon of the practices/aura_bottle book entry written as naturesaura:aura_bottle{stored_type:'naturesaura:overworld'}, is the named result of three advancements, and appears as a forge:nbt ingredient in calling_spirit.json; effect_powder is the declared result of five tree_ritual recipes. Critically these are ONE id each with NBT variants, not 4 and 5 separate ids, so neither can become a wheel. TIER GATE: the analogue of Bewitchment's chalk tier is RITUAL TIER crossed with AURA TYPE. Three ritual tiers exist as distinct recipe types - naturesaura:tree_ritual (17 recipes, gold powder ring plus wood stands, needs only Gold Leaf), naturesaura:altar (36 recipes, the Natural Altar, split into a base set and sets gated behind crushing_catalyst and conversion_catalyst placed under it), and naturesaura:offering (7 recipes, the Offering Table, every one of them requiring a Spirit of Calling). The Spirit of Calling is the hard gate: its recipe demands aura_bottle with stored_type naturesaura:overworld AND stored_type naturesaura:nether in the same grid, so the Nether trip is a recipe-level requirement, not a suggestion. End Aura gates ender_access, end_city_finder, chunk_loader and death_ring the same way. Everything past sky_ingot therefore sits behind two dimensions. ENTITIES: no kill step is offered. The mod registers no hostile mobs of its own; the 60 naturesaura:animal_spawner recipes spawn vanilla passive animals, and killing them would be a vanilla task, not a mod one. OTHER ACQUISITION: birth_spirit and vacuum_bottle have no recipe and are correctly kept - the book states Spirits of Birthing drop when passive animals breed in high Aura, and the Bottled Vacuum is what a Bottle and Cork becomes when used in an area of severe negative Aura imbalance (advancement naturesaura:vacuum_bottle, parented to naturesaura:negative_imbalance, confirms it is reachable). gold_leaf likewise has no recipe: it comes from data/naturesaura/loot_tables/blocks/golden_leaves.json at 75% when the leaves reach stage 3. CONSENSUS: moddb.json has no naturesaura entry, so there is no 6-pack consensus to cross-check. harvested_order.json does carry 12 naturesaura ids - ancient_sapling, conversion_catalyst, nature_altar, furnace_heater, crushing_catalyst, spring, offering_table, death_ring, sky_ingot, generator_limit_remover, oak_generator, depth_ingot - and all 12 exist in the jar. One ordering conflict: it places ancient_sapling and conversion_catalyst before nature_altar, but conversion_catalyst's tree_ritual recipe requires infused_stone and sky_ingot, both of which require the altar, and sky_ingot additionally requires the Offering Table. The recipe graph is preferred and both are moved after the altar and the offering here.
